outcomes.name: cal-takehome-sample
outcomes.about: Take-home sample CSV with +02:00 offsets and its example replies; counters, reminder, unanswered versions

outcomes.name: cal-friday-rollover
outcomes.about: Fri 15:00: Critical gets Fri 17:00 then 19:00 after decline (08-21); High/Low roll to Monday; Low decline avoids refused slot

outcomes.name: cal-weekend-two-critical
outcomes.about: Sat 19:30: two Criticals on Sunday 08:00/10:00, Critical counters to Sunday 12:00; High and Low on Monday

outcomes.name: cal-dst-blackout-weekend
outcomes.about: Sat 24 Oct (+02:00): handyman blacks out Sat+Sun; Criticals move to Mon 26 (+01:00) around the High tentative hold (no takeover on blackout)

outcomes.name: cal-same-hour-priority
outcomes.about: Low then High tenants ask for the same hour: High takes over the Low tentative hold; Low re-proposed without penalty

outcomes.name: cal-takeover-skips-scheduled
outcomes.about: Critical counter range holds a scheduled Low and a tentative Medium: takes the Medium, never the scheduled visit

outcomes.name: cal-preemption-chain
outcomes.about: Critical takes High hold; High then counters into Low hold and takes it; two takeovers, nobody penalised

outcomes.name: cal-blackout-priority
outcomes.about: Blackout today moves High, Medium, Low (CSV order Low first): urgency must win the freed Thursday slots

outcomes.name: cal-blackout-after-scheduled
outcomes.about: Blackout "today from 12:00" after A is scheduled at 12:00: A kept with blackout_conflict; B, C move to Thursday

outcomes.name: cal-blackout-multiday
outcomes.about: Blackout Thu+Fri: three Thursday holds move to Monday; Wednesday holds untouched

outcomes.name: cal-evaluator-seven
outcomes.about: 7 orders mixed urgency, interleaved: accept, counter, reminder, takeover, decline, timeouts, EOF

outcomes.name: cal-equal-urgency
outcomes.about: Medium counters onto another Medium tentative hold: no takeover, no-fit note, fallback avoids refused slot

outcomes.name: cal-handyman-double-book
outcomes.about: Handyman offers the same hour for two orders: High takes it from Medium, Medium re-proposed

outcomes.name: cal-declines-fill
outcomes.about: Declines across three orders push into Thursday; third tenant decline closes A as no_mutual_slot

outcomes.name: cal-future-reported
outcomes.about: reported_at after AGENT_NOW: Critical Thu 08:00, Low Wed 16:00; a counter before reported_at does not fit

outcomes.name: cal-change-after-accept
outcomes.about: Tenant accepts, then narrows to afternoons before the handyman answers; later withdraw on a scheduled order is ignored

outcomes.name: cal-decline-excluded-day
outcomes.about: Decline that rules out a whole day ("Wednesday is impossible"): the next proposal should not be that day again
